summary: Re-test of admin debit-balance feature after frontend error-handling improvements (content-type aware JSON parse, 404/401/403 specific messages). All backend pytest cases (10/10) pass on /app/backend/tests/test_admin_debit_balance.py. Frontend verified end-to-end via Playwright on both AdminUsersPage and AdminActivityPage: Debitar button opens dialog with 'Mantenimiento de cuenta' preset preselected in textarea, submit button is disabled until the confirmation toggle is checked, successful submit shows 'Debitado X USD de Test User · Email enviado' toast and closes the dialog, and clearing the reason via 'Limpiar' triggers 'El motivo es obligatorio (min. 3 caracteres)' toast. Audit endpoint /api/admin/users/{uid}/admin-transactions returned both new admin_debit rows (USD 2.50 from Users page and USD 1.25 from Activity page) with reason='Mantenimiento de cuenta' and admin_name='Admin LIONSBIT'. Activity feed live-rendered both new debit entries (visible in screenshot). Improved error handling did NOT regress the happy path.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminUsersPage.jsx and AdminActivityPage.jsx duplicate the entire handleDebit logic (~55 lines each, content-type parsing, 404/401/403 mapping). Extract into a shared hook (e.g. useAdminDebit) or util to keep both call-sites in sync going forward.

Both pages still call fetch() directly with API_URL/token instead of going through adminAPI.debitBalance — inconsistent with the rest of the admin codebase and makes interceptor-based auth refresh impossible.
AdminUsersPage.jsx is 1,328 lines; the Debit dialog and History dialog should be split into their own components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created via UI during this run on user dea201c1-940b-4ae6-9dc7-403581ebebb9 (Test User): admin_debit USD 2.50 (Users page) and admin_debit USD 1.25 (Activity page), both reason='Mantenimiento de cuenta'. Backend pytest also created its own TEST_ prefixed credit/debit pair.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 100% green in preview. Reusable regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_debit_balance.py (10 tests, ~4s). Test User id=dea201c1-940b-4ae6-9dc7-403581ebebb9. AdminUsersPage debit selectors: data-testid='debit-balance-<user_id>' button → 'debit-balance-dialog' modal → 'debit-confirm-toggle' checkbox → 'debit-submit' button. AdminActivityPage selectors: 'debit-balance-btn-<activity_id>' button → 'activity-debit-confirm' checkbox → 'activity-debit-submit' button. Activity page renders ~100 debit buttons (one per row); the admin/users page renders the Debitar button per-user. NOTE: do NOT use wait_until='networkidle' on these admin pages — long-poll/WebSocket keeps the network busy and goto times out; use 'domcontentloaded' + wait_for_selector for the actual data testid (~20s timeout). The 'Activity success=False' line in the playwright log was a false-negative caused by reading body innerText after toast had auto-dismissed; the audit endpoint and on-screen activity feed both confirmed the debit succeeded.
rca of the issue: Original production error 'Error de conexion al debitar saldo' was caused by handleDebit calling response.json() unconditionally — when the production deploy had not yet shipped the new endpoint and CDN/edge returned an HTML 404, JSON.parse threw and the catch branch produced the generic message. Fix in AdminUsersPage.jsx and AdminActivityPage.jsx now: (1) inspects content-type before JSON parse, (2) maps HTTP 404 to a deploy-instruction message, (3) maps 401/403 to session-expired message, (4) surfaces the actual status + detail otherwise. Verified the happy path still works in preview where the endpoint is deployed.
